Subject: Security qualification follow-up — SOC 2 scope, logs, retention & next steps

Hi Samantha and Martin,

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation. Below is a short recap so we have alignment on pain, goals, and concrete next steps. If I got anything wrong, flag it and I will update.

Key pain points you reiterated
- Regulatory auditors asking for searchable, immutable audit logs across all production inference requests
- Need to understand retention options and cost impact for 90 / 365 / indefinite retention windows
- Requirement to see SOC 2 artifacts and an external pen test report before procurement sign-off

Goals we discussed
- Verify that Redwood can provide an evidence package that satisfies Odyssey Pay's security review by end of month
- Provide a clear retention matrix and delta pricing for our hosted and dedicated deployment options
- Confirm the scope of the pen test and what artifacts we can share versus summary findings

Agreed next steps
1) Redwood to send a short SOC 2 evidence snapshot and a proposed log retention matrix (I will include Karthik for any infra specifics) — targeted by EOD Wed 11/11.
2) Odyssey to confirm which environments must be covered (prod only or staging + prod) and any minimum retention requirement.
3) If DPA signatures are needed early to exchange full artifacts, we will share a DPA draft; legal can sign via DocuSign link.

I will follow up with the attachments and loop in our security team after your confirmation on environment scope.

Thanks,
Lauren

Thanks Lauren — this is helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifications from my side:

- We need evidence for prod initially, but we will require a path for staging as well within 90 days. Prod is the blocker for Q4 procurement.
- For pen test, we need either Redwood's most recent vendor report or a summary of findings with remediation dates. We cannot accept a high-level sentence only.
- Audit log sample: can you provide a redacted sample that shows event types, actor, timestamp, and request/response hashes? It does not need full payloads, but must demonstrate immutability and searchability.

Timelines: if you can share the SOC2 snapshot and retention matrix by Wed 11/11, we will triage internally and let you know whether legal needs the DPA signed first.

Martin, Olivia — looping you in as discussed.

Best,
Samantha Liu

Hi Samantha and team,

Thanks for the clear priorities. Quick plan from our side and what we can deliver this week:

What we will provide by EOD 11/12:
- SOC2 evidence snapshot (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) that maps common auditor asks to the artifacts we can share and the control owner at Redwood.
- Redacted audit log sample demonstrating timestamp, event type, actor id, and request/response hash. This will be sanitized to remove payloads.
- Pen test scope document and a vendor summary (pen-test-scope.pdf) showing which findings are shareable. Full vendor reports require a signed DPA in our standard process.
- SOC2 evidence checklist CSV that lists items commonly requested by financial services buyers (SOC2-evidence-checklist.csv).

Retention guidance and options
- Prod-only baseline: 90 days of hot searchable logs, 365 days archived searchable logs (cost delta in attached matrix).
- If Odyssey requires immutable long-term retention beyond 365 days, we provide WORM archive options; pricing varies and we will include examples in the matrix.

Ask from Odyssey to finalize scope
- Please confirm whether you need staging in scope for the initial procurement sign-off or whether prod coverage is sufficient.
- Confirm the required retention window (90 v 365 v unlimited) and whether PII is expected in logs. If PII must be retained, we will propose tokenization redaction steps.

Next steps
1) If you are ok to exchange full vendor pen test report and detailed SOC2 artifacts, please sign the DPA draft via the DocuSign link Marissa included below. Once DPA is executed we will share all non-public artifacts.
2) If not, we will send redacted artifacts and the summarized pen test findings this week to help your security review.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist.csv (stub), pen-test-scope.pdf (stub)

Regards,
